text:
By Source Staff ,
1 hours ago Photo by Michael Carpenter At 10:00 PM in Maury County, the weather is showing a partly cloudy sky with a current temperature of 64.8°F. Winds are steady at 7.5 mph, with no precipitation reported.
Earlier today, temperatures reached a high of 76.5°F and dipped to a low of 57.9°F. The day remained largely overcast with very minimal precipitation risk, marked at 3%, and no rainfall materialized.
Looking ahead to tonight, conditions are expected to remain overcast with the temperature expected to hover around a low of 63.3°F. Wind speeds will continue at a pace similar to current conditions, up to 7.5 mph, and the chance of precipitation will remain at 0%.
Residents can expect a calm night with stable weather conditions continuing into the early morning.
